MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory cards fit my repeated purchases of storage cards, adapters, and a card reader; a spare card with an adapter would support equipment I already use.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my pattern of buying practical connection accessories, although I would check the ports and needed length before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Owning a Fire 7 does not give me a reason to buy another tablet, especially an older model with much the same purpose.",
    "My TV and DVD player purchases do not mean I am planning a wall installation or looking for streaming equipment; those require a separate need I do not currently have.",
    "The smart speaker and earbuds do not solve a current problem suggested by my accessory purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My ownership of a tablet seems to have been treated as interest in buying more tablets and other Alexa devices.",
    "My TV and DVD player seem to have been taken as reasons to recommend several home entertainment additions, even though I mostly buy accessories for specific uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of cables, storage, holders, and adapters suggest that making existing equipment useful matters more to me right now than adding another device.",
    "Compatibility matters: a memory card adapter adds usefulness, while a cable or mount requires checking the exact connection or fit.",
    "Both memory card listings fit my interests, but I would choose the single card with an adapter this time; interest in spare storage does not mean I need both listings."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my storage and accessory needs but stretched device ownership into assumed demand for more devices and installation projects."
}
